description: This file defines functions and classes related to user-defined functions (UDFs) in PySpark, specifically focusing on pandas and arrow UDFs. It includes UDF type enums, decorator functions for creating UDFs, validation logic, and example usage documentation.

classes.name: PandasUDFType
classes.description: Enumeration of pandas UDF types, including scalar, iterator, grouped map, and grouped aggregate types.

classes.name: ArrowUDFType
classes.description: Enumeration of Arrow UDF types, including scalar, iterator, and grouped aggregate types.

methods.name: arrow_udf
methods.description: Decorator/function to create an Arrow UDF with various input configurations, supporting batch and iterator modes, with extensive usage examples.

methods.name: pandas_udf
methods.description: Decorator/function to create a pandas UDF with extensive support for type hints, validation, and multiple execution modes, including batch and iterator APIs.
